added_models.model: Rat donepezil-potentiation PD models (hippocampal/frontal ACh microdialysis, nPO-evoked and EEG gamma oscillations, awake fMRI)

engagement.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Herrik 2016 (epub 2016-03-31). Amat-Foraster 2017 (frontal gamma, awake EEG; 10.1016/j.neuropharm.2016.09.017), Mork 2017 (mPFC microdialysis; 10.1016/j.ejphar.2017.02.010) and Ferris 2017 (awake fMRI; 10.3389/fphar.2017.00279) extend the same system.
engagement.model: Rat hippocampal ACh microdialysis and nPO-evoked theta/gamma oscillations with donepezil
engagement.note: Idalopirdine potentiated donepezil's hippocampal ACh rise and theta/gamma power in rats; neither ACh nor EEG oscillations were ever measured in idalopirdine-dosed humans.
engagement.short: Rat ACh/EEG potentiation, no human PD
engagement.quote: This study demonstrates that idalopirdine potentiates the effects of donepezil on two pharmacodynamic biomarkers associated with cognition, i.e. neuronal oscillations and extracellular ACh levels in the hippocampus.
engagement.reason: No human ACh or EEG readout published
engagement.judgement: Separate track from the rat occupancy/PCP-NOR system (rat-subchronic-pcp-nor): a different model (donepezil co-administration, PD biomarkers) making a different prediction (idalopirdine adds to an AChEI). The four Lundbeck papers (electrophysiology, microdialysis, fMRI) are one system with one prediction, so one model_id. No idalopirdine EEG, microdialysis or fMRI study in humans was registered or published, so the readout was never checked.

efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
efficacy.model: Rat donepezil-potentiation PD models (hippocampal ACh, network oscillations)
efficacy.note: Lundbeck's AD add-on rationale: idalopirdine potentiates donepezil's effects on hippocampal ACh and network oscillations in rats.
efficacy.quote: Here we investigated the effects of idalopirdine in combination with donepezil on hippocampal function using in vivo electrophysiology and microdialysis.
efficacy.judgement: Opener at first publication (epub 2016-03-31). The same paper already states the comparison with LADDER, recorded as the next entry.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: potentiation of donepezil PD biomarkers in rat vs LADDER ADAS-cog gain of 2.16 points; no common quantity
efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. LADDER registry NCT01019421 has no results posted; Wilkinson 2014 epub 2014-10-05 is the patient-side record.

patient_trials.quote: At week 24, the change from baseline in ADAS-cog total score was +1·38 (SD 0·53) in the placebo group and -0·77 (0·55) in the idalopirdine group (treatment difference of -2·16 points, 95% CI -3·62 to -0·69; p=0·0040).

efficacy.model: Rat donepezil-potentiation PD models (hippocampal ACh, network oscillations)
efficacy.note: Run after LADDER (2014): rat potentiation of donepezil's ACh and oscillation effects is offered as the mechanism of LADDER's 2.16-point ADAS-cog gain.
efficacy.short: Reproduces LADDER add-on benefit, post hoc
efficacy.quote: Such potentiation could contribute to the procognitive effects of idalopirdine observed in donepezil-treated AD patients.
efficacy.judgement: Retrodiction: LADDER (Wilkinson 2014) was known and is cited in the abstract as the premise ('A recent phase 2 trial showed ...'), so retro, not same (decision 10). Mork 2017 Eur J Pharmacol states the same comparison more explicitly ('may provide a mechanistic model for the pro-cognitive effects ... in the phase 2 studies (Wilkinson et al. 2014)'). Direction only: the rat readouts are PD biomarkers, not cognition.

efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
efficacy.confidence_note: Atri 2018 abstract read; registry results for STARSHINE (NCT01955161) posted 2017-09-19 set the year. Atri's Discussion (checker-verified) reports >80% 5-HT6 occupancy at 30 and 60 mg/d in healthy volunteers, data not shown.

patient_trials.quote: In study 1, the mean change in ADAS-Cog total score between baseline and 24 weeks was 0.37 for the 60-mg dose of idalopirdine group, 0.61 for the 30-mg dose group, and 0.41 for the placebo group
In study 2, the mean change in ADAS-Cog total score between baseline and 24 weeks was 1.01 for the 30-mg dose of idalopirdine group, 0.53 for the 10-mg dose group, and 0.56 for the placebo group
In study 3, the mean change in ADAS-Cog total score between baseline and 24 weeks was 0.38 for the 60-mg dose of idalopirdine group and 0.82 for the placebo group

efficacy.model: Rat donepezil-potentiation PD models (hippocampal ACh, network oscillations)
efficacy.note: The model's prospective prediction, an add-on benefit on donepezil, failed in three Phase 3 trials (2,525 patients, 10-60 mg/d on a cholinesterase inhibitor).
efficacy.quote: In patients with mild to moderate AD, the use of idalopirdine compared with placebo did not improve cognition over 24 weeks of treatment.
efficacy.reason: Rat add-on synergy; three Phase 3 nulls
efficacy.judgement: First prospective test after the retrodiction (decision 10): the model was published in 2016, the Phase 3 results in 2017. Contra beats the retro on the same track. Phase 3 doses (10-60 mg/d) were below LADDER's 90 mg/d, but the add-on was tested at the occupancy target (>80% at 30-60 mg/d per Atri's Discussion), so the null is not a dose miss. Atri 2018 does not put the rat model beside the result, so the pairing is mine (model_src Herrik 2016).

added_models.model: Healthy-volunteer scopolamine challenge (CogState battery, donepezil 10 mg positive control)

efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry record only: 38 subjects, 5-way crossover, single doses 5/20/60 mg vs donepezil 10 mg, Groton Maze Learning Task primary; completed 2011-08, no results posted. Not reported in Fullerton 2018 (PMC5887246 full text searched for 'scopolamine') nor in any PubMed-indexed SAM-760 paper.
efficacy.model: Healthy-volunteer scopolamine challenge (CogState battery, donepezil 10 mg positive control)
efficacy.note: Pfizer's proof-of-mechanism: SAM-760 5-60 mg against scopolamine deficits in 38 healthy adults (2010-11); never reported, so the Phase 2 futility cannot be compared.
efficacy.short: Human scopolamine challenge run, never reported
efficacy.quote: It is hypothesized that PF-05212377 (SAM-760) will reverse scopolamine induced cognitive impairments in healthy adults subjects.
efficacy.judgement: A human pharmacological challenge is a model system (brief: 'the system was not an animal'). It existed and was used for a member drug before Phase 2 (NCT01712074, 2012), but no admissible result exists to compare with the Phase 2 futility stop (Fullerton 2018), so untested rather than an empty list. Engagement and dose cells are not opened: the challenge is itself a human readout and no exposure target from it is public.

efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor
efficacy.model: Rodent cognition assays for SAM-760 (cholinergic/glutamatergic deficit object recognition)
efficacy.confidence_note: AAIC 2011 supplement abstract (Comery 2011, Alzheimers Dement 7(4S):S794, doi resolves, abstract read on Wiley); the rodent data themselves were never published, only this sponsor summary sentence. The assay list (MK-801, scopolamine, combined deficit object recognition) comes from a review (Biomolecules 2023, PMC9953539 Table 2), which is a pointer, not a source.
efficacy.note: Pfizer reported SAM-760 as pro-cognitive in multiple rodent assays (object recognition reversal of MK-801/scopolamine deficits per review) before Phase 2; the data were never published.
efficacy.quote: SAM-760 has demonstrated pro-cognitive effects in multiple rodent assays.
efficacy.judgement: Opener at first public statement of SAM-760's own efficacy model (answers rule question 5: Pfizer did state one, in a conference abstract). A member drug's own model, different drug and deficit paradigm from idalopirdine's subchronic-PCP NOR and masupirdine's battery, so its own track per the drafter's member-model convention. Admissibility rests on the supplement-abstract rule question; the adjudication already accepted Schmidt 2014 (Alzheimers Dement supplement) at low confidence.

efficacy.population: Unselected mild-to-moderate AD dementia, add-on to a cholinesterase inhibitor

patient_trials.quote: The mean week 12 treatment difference was 0.70 points ( P = 0.43) for ADAS-cog13 and 2.19 points ( P = 0.20) for NPI score, both of which were numerically in favor of placebo.

efficacy.model: Rodent cognition assays for SAM-760 (cholinergic/glutamatergic deficit object recognition)
efficacy.confidence_note: Patient side high (Fullerton 2018 full text, PMC5887246; NCT01712074 results posted 2017-03-20 set the year); model side is a one-sentence conference-abstract summary, so medium overall.
efficacy.note: SAM-760 30 mg on donepezil was stopped for futility at interim (ADAS-cog13 difference 0.70 points favouring placebo), against the rodent pro-cognitive prediction.
efficacy.quote: SAM-760 was safe and well tolerated, but there was no benefit of SAM-760 on measures of cognition, neuropsychiatric symptoms, or daily function.
efficacy.judgement: Prospective: the rodent claim (2011) predates the trial (registered 2012). Fullerton 2018 does not put the rodent data beside the result, so the pairing is mine (model_src Comery 2011). Occupancy was saturated at 30 mg (dose 4), so not a dose miss.

considered_not_added: Healthy-volunteer PET 5-HT6 occupancy of idalopirdine (unpublished; Atri 2018 Discussion): not a model system but the human side of the existing rat occupancy track (rat-subchronic-pcp-nor); it belongs to the checker's corrections of engagement 5 / dose 5, not to a new track.

Cornery 2011 AAIC abstract (SAM-760 occupancy in NHP and healthy volunteers, Alzheimers Dement 7:S794): the same system as the existing nhp-pet-5ht6-occupancy track; a dating question for its 2023 engagement entry, not a new track.
Idalopirdine systematic review and meta-analysis (Int Psychogeriatr 2019, PMID 30560763): patient-side tier 4 only, no model; could sit in patient_trials of the existing efficacy entry 3.

QSP cortical-circuit model (Roberts, Spiros, Geerts 2012, 10.1186/alzrt153; Geerts 2013 Front Pharmacol; Geerts 2017 Eur J Pharmacol; Geerts & Spiros 2020 J Alzheimers Dis): the model was calibrated on 5-HT6 antagonist ADAS-Cog data rather than predicting a member drug; no stated prospective 5-HT6 prediction compared with idalopirdine, SAM-760 or masupirdine outcomes was found at abstract level.
SAM-760 5-HT2A PET in healthy volunteers (NCT02005991; Lockwood 2015 CPT abstract): a human selectivity check cited by Fullerton 2018, not a model with a patient comparison.
Rat Parkinson's-disease falls model with idalopirdine + donepezil or rivastigmine (Kucinski 2017 Eur J Neurosci; 2019 Psychopharmacology): another indication, no patient comparison in AD.
Rat excessive-eating / obesity models of idalopirdine (Metab Brain Dis 2015, 2018): not AD, no patient comparison.
Human post-mortem 5-HT6 expression (~40% lower in AD cortex; Lorke 2006, cited by Atri 2018 as a caveat): a tissue observation, no prediction compared with patient response.

Ferris 2017 'clinically relevant exposure' statement for the potentiation doses: no new exposure target; the idalopirdine dose question is carried by the rat occupancy track for the same drug and exposures, so no dose cell was opened on the potentiation track.
Rat P-gp brain-penetration and NHP PET occupancy systems for SAM-760, masupirdine rat cognition battery, IND toxicology: already tracked in the draft.
